title: Extra Cheesy Bean-Loaded Jacket Potatoes
subtitle: with Mixed Salad Leaves & Spring Onion
description:
Elevate the humble beans on toast, with this mouthwatering pairing of cannellini beans tossed in a garlicky tomato sauce sitting atop crispy, air fried potato. Add a sprinkling of spring onion for some additional colour and crunch.
No air fryer? Follow along with our alternative method for a final result that will be just as tasty!

steps.text:
•
    •
  • Set air fryer to 200°C. Cut potato in half. Using a fork, prick holes all over potato.
    • •
  • Place potato on a large microwave-safe plate. Splash with water and cover with a damp paper towel. Microwave potato on high, until slightly tender, 5 mins.
    • •
  • Remove paper towel and drizzle potato with olive oil and a good pinch of salt and toss to coat. Place potato into the air fryer basket, cut-side down and cook until golden and tender, 12-15 mins.
    • •
•

NO AIR FRYER? Preheat oven to 200°C/180°C fan-forced. Cut potato in half. Place on a lined oven tray. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and toss to coat. Arrange cut-side down and roast until crisp and tender, 40-45 mins.

•
    •
  • Meanwhile, finely chop or crush garlic.
    • •
  • Thinly slice spring onion (see ingredients).
    • •
  • Drain and rinse cannellini beans.
    • •

•
    •
  • In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat.
    • •
  • Cook cannellini beans until softened, 2-3 mins. 
    • •
  • Add paprika spice blend, garlic and tomato paste and cook until fragrant, 1 min. 
    • •
  • Stir in the water and butter and simmer until slightly reduced, 1-2 mins.
    • •
  • Remove pan from heat and lightly mash beans. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
    • •

•
    •
  • In a medium bowl, combine a drizzle of olive oil and vinegar. Add mixed salad leaves and toss to coat. Season to taste.
    • •
  • Divide jacket potatoes between plates. 
    • •
  • Top with Cheddar cheese, bean filling and Parmesan cheese.
    • •
  • Sprinkle over crispy shallots and spring onion. 
    • •
  • Serve with mixed salad leaves.
    • •
